metadata.title: Trustora — Trust. Verify. Shop.
metadata.description: Digital trust infrastructure for Sri Lankan social commerce.

home.title: Know who you are buying from — before you pay.
home.body: Trustora brings verified business identity, real transaction outcomes and transparent evidence together, so customers can make informed decisions and honest Sri Lankan SMEs can stand out.

business.title: Business Trust
business.question: Can I trust this business?
business.body: Verified identity, documentation, contact details, linked social accounts and platform history.

product.title: Product Trust
product.question: Can I trust this product?
product.body: Product information, supplier and authenticity evidence, and customer reports.

transaction.title: Transaction Trust
transaction.question: Can I trust this transaction?
transaction.body: Completed orders, delivery performance, refunds, disputes and verified reviews.

home.principleBody: Trustora never claims a seller is 100% safe. Trust levels describe what the available verified and observed evidence shows today, and they change as new evidence arrives.

onboarding.title: Register your business
onboarding.body: Create your Trustora store. You can add products, link your social accounts and apply for verification next.
onboarding.name: Business / store name
onboarding.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Your store will be at /stores/{slug}. This cannot be changed later.

dashboard.title: Business overview
dashboard.notPublished: Your store is not public yet.
dashboard.checklistBody: Each step adds evidence customers can see.

steps.policies: Publish returns, refunds and delivery policies
steps.social: Link and confirm a social media account

store.title: Store settings
store.logoHint: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB.
store.contactHint: Changing contact details after verification removes the “contact confirmed” mark until Trustora confirms them again.
store.policiesHint: Clear policies are a positive trust signal. Write them in one or both languages.
store.published: Published — customers can see your store
store.unpublished: Draft — only you can see your store

social.title: Social media accounts
social.body: Link the accounts where you sell. To confirm ownership, add your Trustora code to the account’s bio or about section. A Trustora administrator will check it.

verification.title: Business verification
verification.body: Upload your business registration (BR) certificate and any supporting document. Documents are stored privately and only Trustora administrators can view them.
verification.documentsHint: 1–5 files. PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 10 MB each.
verification.pendingNotice: Your verification request is being reviewed.
verification.verifiedNotice: Your business is verified. Customers see the verified badge on your store.
verification.rejectedNotice: Your last request was not approved. Review the note below and submit again.

products.title: Products
products.empty: You have not added any products yet.
products.name: Product name
products.imagesHint: Up to 8 images. JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB each.
products.evidenceBody: Upload invoices, supplier or distributor documents, or authenticity certificates. Trustora reviews this evidence — uploading it does not mark a product as verified.

store.notVerifiedHint: This business has not completed Trustora verification. Check its evidence carefully before buying.
store.noPolicies: This store has not published its policies.
store.fallbackLanguage: Shown in the language provided by the seller.

verifications.title: SME verification
verifications.decisionHint: Approve only if the registration details match an official record. Your decision and note are recorded in the audit log.
verifications.contactVerified: I confirmed the business contact details
verifications.documentsMisleading: Documents appear forged or belong to another business (recorded as a verified risk finding)

social.title: Social account confirmation
social.body: Open the profile and check that the code appears in the bio or about section.

VERIFIED.label: Verified & trusted
VERIFIED.description: A verified business with a strong record of completed transactions, based on available evidence.

TRUSTED.label: Trusted
TRUSTED.description: Trusted based on available evidence, including a record of completed transactions.

DEVELOPING.label: Developing
DEVELOPING.description: Some positive evidence, but not enough transaction history yet to call this business trusted.

CAUTION.label: Caution
CAUTION.description: Limited or concerning evidence. Check the details below carefully before buying.

HIGH_RISK.label: High risk
HIGH_RISK.description: Verified negative findings. Trustora recommends extra care before dealing with this business.

trustDimension.PRODUCT_question: Can I trust the product information?
trustDimension.TRANSACTION_question: Can I trust a transaction with them?

trustSuggestions.RESOLVE_MISLEADING_EVIDENCE: Some of your evidence was found to be misleading. Contact Trustora support to resolve it.
trustSuggestions.CONFIRM_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT: Link a social media account and add your Trustora code to its bio.
trustSuggestions.COMPLETE_PROFILE: Add a logo and a store description.
trustSuggestions.ADD_PRODUCT_EVIDENCE: Upload authenticity evidence for {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}.
trustSuggestions.BUILD_TRANSACTION_HISTORY: Complete orders on Trustora to build transaction trust.

passport.title: Digital Trust Passport
passport.subtitle: What the available evidence says about {name}
passport.whyTitle: Why should I trust this business?
passport.whyBody: Every point in the score comes from one of these signals. Each shows where the information comes from.
passport.noRisks: No risk signals found in the available evidence.
passport.methodology: Scores are calculated by Trustora's rules from verified and observed evidence (method {version}). They are not generated by AI and are not a guarantee.
passport.disclaimer: Trust levels describe the evidence available today and can change over time. Trustora never claims a seller is 100% safe.
passport.historyTitle: Trust score over the last {days} days
passport.historyIncreased: Trust score increased from {from} to {to} during the last {days} days.
passport.historyDecreased: Trust score decreased from {from} to {to} during the last {days} days.
passport.historyUnchanged: Trust score unchanged at {to} during the last {days} days.
passport.chartLabel: Line chart of the trust score over time

smeTrust.title: Your Trust Passport
smeTrust.body: This is what customers see. Your score updates automatically when evidence changes.
smeTrust.noSuggestions: Nothing to add right now — keep completing orders well.

adminEvidence.title: Trust & evidence review
adminEvidence.body: Review authenticity evidence submitted by SMEs. Decisions update product authenticity and trust scores immediately and are audit-logged.
adminEvidence.misleading: Misleading (appears forged or does not match) — counts as a verified risk finding
